customers_say: Customers find the smart lock worth its price and appreciate its straightforward installation process. The device offers comprehensive features, with one customer noting its multiple unlocking options, and provides good security with an anti-pry/tamper alarm. They like its stylish appearance and find it convenient to use, with one mentioning the camera's usefulness. Customers value the service and support provided by the company.

reviews.author: Sai
reviews.title: Great lock and great support from Lavna team
reviews.body: Really good smart lock! It works well and has a lot of features that can keep your house safe. The customer support is really responsive and they helped me go inside my house when the battery died, All in a simple video call! Special thanks to Jatin who handles the LA44 model support, He instructed me every step of way to reset locks, use emergency power ports, etc.
